name: pam_echo
detailed_description: Simple debugging and informational module that displays text messages during PAM authentication flow. Useful for providing user feedback or debugging PAM configurations. Messages are sent to the user's terminal.

parameters.file: Path to file containing message to echo

notes:
Utility module for displaying messages during authentication; useful for debugging and informational messages.
